body.file: SNES - Batman Returns - Playable Characters - Batman.png

scout_death.label: DEATH
scout_death.note: disc scanner destroyed: rotor bends, sparks, sinks

crew_a.label: DEATH (mislabelled)
crew_a.note: operator A: raises and fires a sidearm, holsters

crew_b.label: IDLE (mislabelled)
crew_b.note: operator B: draws and fires, recovers

crew_c.label: WALK (mislabelled)
crew_c.note: operator C (cyber arm): aims and fires, recovers — standing in place, not walking

carrier_back.label: BACK (= collapse)
carrier_back.note: carrier frame sags and its deck buckles — the actual destruction

carrier_hover.label: DEATH (= hover)
carrier_hover.note: intact carrier with down-thrust lines — arrival / delivery hover

carrier_move.label: IDLE (= lateral)
carrier_move.note: intact carrier with side jets — lateral transit

heli_land.label: LANDING
heli_land.note: descent with hook lowered (pickup approach); 8th cell clipped by the sheet edge — not used

plane_drop.label: DROP
plane_drop.note: bomb-bay opens, payload shows under the fuselage

hunter.label: Hunter row 1
hunter.note: bipedal walker: step, step, fire (muzzle flash), fire

hunter_turn.label: Hunter row 2
hunter_turn.note: the same walker facing back, firing behind it

lurker.label: Lurker
lurker.note: tracked cannon: rest, firing (the long line is its shot streak)

steelwing.label: Steel Wing
steelwing.note: winged gun flyer: three banking cells (muzzle flashes included) + level strafe with flash

defender.label: Defender row 1
defender.note: tracked launcher: rack flat, rack raised, gun mount, gun firing

defender2.label: Defender row 2
defender2.note: launcher variant: rack raised (alt), scanner dome mount

ammo.label: Defender pieces
ammo.note: loose launcher pieces: missile pod (flat), gun mount, missile pod (angled) — used as arcing rounds

auto_a1.label: ATTACK1
auto_a1.note: arm blaster: aim, beam, beam breaks up, recover

auto_a3.label: ATTACK3
auto_a3.note: crouch, shoulder cannon forward, heavy cyan beam, recover

auto_a4.label: ATTACK4
auto_a4.note: arm thrust stepping in place — used as the brace / reposition stride (no damage)

labels_excluded.promo sheets: row labels lie left of every art rect (x < first rect) — never sampled
